risks.risk: Headlights are not from an Audi A8L 2015, or are not original equipment (OEM) parts.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the back of one headlight showing the manufacturer label, part number, or VIN stamp, or a photo showing the headlight installed on an Audi A8L 2015.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic aftermarket headlights, not as OEM Audi parts.

risks.risk: Headlights are damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken LEDs, or missing components).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens surface, internal LED array, and electrical connectors from all angles, including a test video showing lights turning on.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly non-functional or with hidden damage.

risks.risk: Headlights are not a matching pair (e.g., different models, left/right mismatch, or different production years).
risks.proof: Side-by-side comparison photo showing both headlights from the same angle, with visible part numbers or model identifiers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mismatched or unverified pair.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the back of one headlight showing any labels, part numbers, or manufacturer marks.
Photo of the headlights installed on a car, preferably an Audi A8L 2015, to confirm fitment.
Close-up of the lens and internal components to check for cracks or damage.
Video showing the headlights turning on and functioning.
response.reason: The seller claims these are Audi A8L 2015 headlights, but no brand or model markings are visible in the photos. Without proof of origin, fitment, or condition, the item cannot be priced accurately. The risk of non-OEM, mismatched, or damaged parts is high, requiring further evidence before pricing.
